verdict: Meta leads doubled this week; Google spend with zero conversions is being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 94 leads through Meta at an average cost of $8.79 per lead — and in just the past 7 days, lead volume doubled while cost per lead dropped 58%. That momentum is real and confirmed. On the other side, Google Ads spent $2,049 across the same 28-day window and recorded zero tracked conversions, with the top search campaign alone accounting for $1,409 of that with no measurable output — conversion tracking is being repaired and offline conversion import is scheduled to go live this month. Separately, 103 leads entered the pipeline this period but none have progressed to an appointment or closed opportunity, which points to a routing or intake gap that is being addressed alongside the CRM build completion.
